about.title: About GD Fashion Store
about.intro: Welcome to GD Fashion Store — a fashion destination created to make stylish, comfortable and quality clothing accessible to everyone.

store.title: About GD Fashion Store
store.description1: GD Fashion Store is an online fashion store focused on providing a variety of modern outfits for different styles, occasions and lifestyles.
store.description2: Our goal is to create a simple and enjoyable shopping experience where customers can discover clothing they love without unnecessary complexity.

founder.title: Founder & Owner
founder.name: Min Myo Aung
founder.description: Founder and owner of GD Fashion Store, responsible for the direction of the brand, product selection and overall vision of the store.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: Our vision is to build a trusted fashion brand where customers can confidently find clothing that matches their personality, lifestyle and individual sense of style.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: We aim to provide products that meet our quality expectations.

style.title: Style
style.description: We continuously look for styles that match modern fashion trends.

customers.title: Customers
customers.description: Customer satisfaction is at the heart of our business.

suppliers.title: Suppliers & Product Partners
suppliers.description1: GD Fashion Store works with selected suppliers and product partners to source fashion items for our customers.
suppliers.description2: We carefully consider product quality, design, availability and value when selecting products for our store.

promise.title: Our Promise
promise.description: We aim to make every step of the shopping experience straightforward — from discovering products to placing an order and receiving your items.

development.title: Website Development
development.description1: The GD Fashion Store website was designed and developed by
development.description2: The platform was developed to provide a modern, responsive and user-friendly shopping experience across desktop and mobile devices.

copyright.title: Copyright & Intellectual Property
copyright.description: All original website content, design elements and software developed specifically for GD Fashion Store are protected by applicable intellectual property rights.

footer.thankYou: Thank you for choosing GD Fashion Store.
